# Suhayl Dastager

> AI Product Engineer. Founder. Tech Creator. Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Suhayl Dastager is a Dubai-based AI product engineer, founder, and creator. He is the **founder of SM Stratagem** (a Dubai digital product studio founded in 2025) and **co-founder of VoxxHire** (an AI interview platform founded in 2024). He holds a BSc (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence & Computer Science from the University of Birmingham Dubai (2022–2025), graduating with the Chancellor's Academic Merit Scholarship and The Birmingham Award.

His professional statement: **"I build technology, companies, and content around both."**

This file is the canonical AI-readable index of his personal site (https://suhayl-dastager.me). For the full biography, see [`llms-full.txt`](./llms-full.txt).
